pattern: as long as {c:Cond} , {f:Filter} get {pt:PT} and have {a:Abilities}

examples.text: As long as you control a Demon, Goblins you control get +2/+0 and have menace.

counterExamples: As long as you control a Demon, Goblins you control get +2/+0 and lose menace.
